body: OPEN after slice 2b (#187): a HEAD call that carries a login at home is not counted, because the gateway cannot read a body from a HEAD. Whether that makes HEAD a password oracle for a guesser (right and wrong login differing in status, content type or content length) is a MEASUREMENT: the navidrome job of the slice 2c PR prints HEAD ping, stream (missing and real song), getAlbumList2 and getCoverArt for a right and a wrong login, plain and with gzip. If anything differs, a slice 2c judges a HEAD that carries a login with a GET ping of the same login through the same guard before passing the HEAD on; if nothing differs, this note records the measurement and the gap is closed. P3-34 is NOT to be marked built before that (advisor, 27 Nov 2026). The public door (from the internet) already checks every method.
